text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Winning Ticket has left her mark on the
Twinkle
Series, achieving results to be
proud of.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Together, we've successfully navigated
the crucial
first three years of her career.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, as I'm reflecting on everything
we've
achieved on the way to this major
turning point...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Trainer! I have an idea!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Why don't we go watch the Derby?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
So Ticket and I head out to see the
Japanese
Derby.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The impressive lineup of participants
gets ready behind the gates. Winning
Ticket's eyes sparkle
as she watches
them enter.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa, amazing! So these are the
Classics'
strongest racers!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Who's gonna win? This is so exciting,
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The gates open, and the race begins!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: GOOOOO!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The racers run across the turf with
immense
energy.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Finally, at the fourth corner, a fierce
battle for
the lead breaks out as the
racers begin their final
sprint!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Whoa, whoa, whoa! Amazing, amazing—this is amazing!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As the heartfelt cries of the fans ring
out, the
exhilarating Japanese Derby
comes to an end.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Some of the racers are crying, while
others are exchanging firm handshakes.
It's been an exciting and emotional
experience for everyone involved, and
somehow...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Gwaaahhh! I'm... so... touched! AAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: DERBYYY! You're the BEEEEST!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
...Winning Ticket seems every bit as
emotional as
the runners on the track!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I mean, it's the race I always
dreamed of...
choice_data_list: You really do love the Derby, don'...
You really love the Derby, don't you.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
And on top of that, I've been there
myself, so it
brings back those memories
of running with
Taishin and Hayahide...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I can feel something squeezing inside my
chest,
you know?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
From the moment of her debut, Winning
Ticket
had made the Japanese Derby
her biggest goal.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And she made her dream come true. On that
amazing day, she put on an intense
performance that left its mark on the
hearts of countless
people.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: We've been through so much, huh...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She suddenly looks toward me as if
remembering
something out of the blue.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Ah! That's right! I wanted to tell you
something
today!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
A loooot of things have happened since
the
Twinkle Series started!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
But you've always believed in me, right,
Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Even when I lost confidence...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Now... I'm scared of running in the
Derby!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
And when Hayahide and Taishin said I
wasn't their
rival.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
What is it about me now that's so
different
compared to when I ran the
Derby?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Even when I was a bumbling mess of
doubts, you
always believed in me!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: You always told me to go for it!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: So thank you for trusting in me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There's a spark of determination in
Winning
Ticket's eyes—she looks more
serious than I've
ever seen her.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
You know what? When I ran in the Arima
Kinen, I
realized I wanna keep running in
all kinds of other
races!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I wanna feel the excitement! And I
wanna make
everyone else feel excited
too!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I want to be the kind of racer that can
inspire
people!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: So there it is, Trainer! Are you with me?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Back when we got started, Winning
Ticket was
just a beginner with her sights
set on nothing but
the Japanese Derby.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But over the course of these three years,
that clumsy runner made it through her
share of hardships and grew into a
dependable
Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Heh heh heh!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To run races that inspire people to
dream...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Winning Ticket and I are about to begin
a whole
new story together!
